question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**be**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage uses a conditional structure ('If a child...'), which typically requires the verb form 'be' in the infinitive form after the condition.
 
• 'Be' is used in its infinitive form in conditional clauses to refer to the state or condition of the subject (the child). In this case, it indicates the possibility or hypothetical nature of the situation.
 
• Other options like **are**, **has**, and **is** would not work here as they are not the correct verb forms to use in this conditional sentence structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Childhood is a time when there are few responsibilities to make life difficult. If a child (1) **has **__good parents and they are fed, looked after and loved, whatever they may do, it is improbable that they will ever again in life (2) __be__ given so much without having to do anything in return. In addition, life is always presenting new things to the child. A child finds pleasure in playing in the rain or in the snow. Their first visit to the seaside is a marvelous adventure. However, a child has their pains; they are not free to do as they wish; they are continually being told not to do things or are being (3)_____. Their life is therefore not perfectly happy. When the young individual starts to earn their own living, they become free from the discipline of school and parents, but at the same time they are forced to accept responsibilities. They can no longer expect others to pay for food, clothes and room, but they have to work if they want to live (4)_____. If they spend most of their time playing about in the way that they used to as a child, they will go hungry. Moreover, if they break the laws of society just as they used to break the laws of their parents, they may go to prison. However, by working, keeping out of (5)_____ and having good health, they can have the great happiness of seeing themselves make steady progress in their job and of building up for themselves their own position in society.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Are**: This is incorrect as it is the present tense of the verb, and does not fit the conditional structure of the sentence.
 
• **Has**: This is incorrect as it is the third person singular present tense, which doesn't match the structure of the sentence.
 
• **Is**: This is incorrect because the sentence needs the base form of the verb after the conditional 'If'.
